text.p: - NATO has made maximum of concessions to Russia in the run-up to the bloc's eastwards expansion.
- Russia is at a crossroads again, says newly-appointed First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov in an interview.
- Former first deputy prime minister Vladimir Potanin says the new government will meet fierce resistance from natural monopolies, unwilling to reform.
- Over 20 million people may take part in a social protest agaisnt delayed wages and pensions planned for March 27.
- Defence Minister Igor Rodionov says he is satisfied with his ministry's relations with Britain.
- Even if the Russian-American summit in Helsinki fails to achieve positive results one should not regard it as a tragedy.
- The first changes in the government show that President Boris Yeltsin does not have a clear plan of how to proceed with reforms.
